turns.input: Sister Mereth gives Nicco a pair of leather boots.
turns.narration:
Sister Mereth stands in Heartstone Square, the heavy key ring at her waist catching the light. She pulls a worn pair of leather boots from her document bag and extends them toward Nicco without ceremony. "From Saint Orra's stores," she says, her voice level and practical. "They're sturdy enough. You'll want proper footwear if you're walking Calderan's streets."

The boots hang in the space between them, her grey eyes meeting his with the brusque patience of someone who has given away goods too many times to make a show of it. She does not withdraw the offer, nor does she press it upon him—simply waits to see whether he will take them.

turns.input:
Thanks *he said to them, after which he decides to give them back the boots*
You'll need them more than me
turns.narration:
Nicco thanks Sister Mereth and extends the boots back toward her. "You'll need them more than me."

Sister Mereth does not reach for them. Her tired face goes still, then draws tighter. "I don't need boots." A short pause. "Saint Orra's children do. You're refusing them?"

She stands with her arms at her sides, the large key ring at her belt catching the daylight, her document bag pressed against her hip. The boots remain in her hands until someone takes them.
